literal_meaning: হাত কানে রাখা (hand on the ear to place)
figurative_meaning_en: to deny or refuse to acknowledge
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার দোষ স্বীকার করতে চায় না, হাত কানে রেখেছে।
বাবা আমার কথা শুনতে হাত কানে রেখেছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't want to admit his fault; he's put his hand to his ear.
Dad has turned a deaf ear to my words.
note: This idiom visually represents ignoring or denying by pretending not to hear, a common gesture in Bengali culture.
